    Din, Hin, Win,
    Dout, Hout, Wout,

    sIC_w, sOCG_w, sKD_w, sKH_w, sKW_w,
    sN_y, sC_y, sD_y, sH_y, sW_y,
    stride_d, stride_h, stride_w,
    pad_d, pad_h, pad_w,
    outpad_d, outpad_h, outpad_w,

    num_w_blocks,

    KERNEL_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_W: tl.constexpr,
    IC_PER_G: tl.constexpr,
    OUT_PER_G: tl.constexpr,
    DTYPE_CODE: tl.constexpr,  # 0: fp32, 1: fp16, 2: bf16

    pid1 = tl.program_id(1)  # oc index

    w_block = pid0 % num_w_blocks
    row = pid0 // num_w_blocks

    dh_total = Dout * wh_total

    n = row // dh_total
    tmp = row % dh_total
    od = tmp // wh_total
    oh = tmp % wh_total

    oc = pid1

    ow_offsets = w_block * BLOCK_W + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_W)
    mask_ow = ow_offsets < Wout

    # Group-related indices
    out_per_g = OUT_PER_G
    g = oc // out_per_g
    oc_in_g = oc - g * out_per_g
    ic_base = g * IC_PER_G

        acc += tl.cast(bval, tl.float32)

    oh_pad = oh + pad_h
    ow_pad = ow_offsets + pad_w

        n * sN_y
        + oc * sC_y
        + od * sD_y
